content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Generic injectable and inhalation drugs and diagnostics, not orthopedic devices sold to surgeons."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Rare genetic disease drugs and gene therapies, a pharmaceutical business rather than orthopedic devices."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Orthopedic devices like bone growth stimulators and cartilage repair, sold to surgeons and clinics, matching the target's products and customers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Consumer-facing continuous glucose monitoring for diabetes, a different product and patient base."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Cardiovascular heart valves and hemodynamic monitoring sold to cardiac centers, not orthopedic products."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Surgical implants and instruments sold to surgeons and hospitals, including orthopedic implants, though neurosurgery and wound care dominate."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Noninvasive patient monitoring and consumer wearables with software, a different product category."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Branded injectable pain drugs and a nerve-pain device, a pharmaceutical model rather than orthopedic devices."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Sleep apnea and respiratory devices sold to home care providers, unrelated to orthopedic products."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Medical tapes, dental products and health information software and services, a diversified mix outside orthopedics."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Sterilizers, surgical tables and contract sterilization services, equipment and services rather than orthopedic implants."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Vascular access, interventional and anesthesia devices, sharing hospital customers but not orthopedic products."}]}
